text_block_list.text:
The day after concluding our activities on 
the expedition—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san, have you decided what to do 
after checking out? We still have quite a 
bit of time until the Shinkansen.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~? I haven't really thought about it 
much. Just buying some souvenirs, maybe. 
What about you, Ikuno?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I've put together a few routes that visit 
some sightseeing spots. Would you like to 
come along, if you're interested?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, the rumored "Ikuno Tours"! I'd be 
delighted to join you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Helios and the others said that whenever 
you go on an away match with Ikuno, she 
looks into everything and gives you a tour 
of the area.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Is that what the rumors are saying? I 
hope I can live up to their expectations, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The first option is a literature and 
history tour. We would visit the 
Literature Memorial Hall and the castle. 
For lunch, the local specialty, meat udon, 
comes highly recommended.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Next is the shopping street tour. We'll 
hop around several shopping districts with 
different vibes. There are udon and 
yaki-udon shops nearby too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
A shopping street! Now that's my kind of 
course~. Don't you think we could find 
some souvenirs here to avoid the dreaded 
"accidental duplicate gift" problem?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's head to the shopping 
district where there are lots of stores.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Now then, how about we grab a bite to eat 
first? Let's hit up an udon place, and 
then get some yakiudon after that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hm? You were curious about the udon, 
right? Might as well indulge in all the 
local specialties while we're here!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
At a place like this, you can just ask 
them for half-portions or to share, so 
don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Just leave that kind of negotiation to 
Nature-san.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... In that case, I'll gladly take you 
up on that. Let's go on an all-you-can-eat 
udon tour!
